page_title: MAR 0-0 LIL | Marseille v Lille 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
90+3' Amine Harit (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Yusuf Yazici will be replaced by Jonathan David (Lille).
90' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) has come on for Angel Gomes.
90' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
89' Marseille couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lucas Chevalier (Lille) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
88' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
87' Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
87' A cross into the box from Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is cleared.
87' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
83' The resulting corner, taken by Remy Cabella (Lille), comes to nothing.
82' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
82' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
80' Angel Gomes (Lille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Pau Lopez easily deals with the threat.
79' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova leaves the pitch and is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
77' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to make a change. Vitinha (Marseille) replaces Ismaila Sarr.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joaquin Correa (Marseille) for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
76' A pass from Amine Harit (Marseille) is intercepted by Lucas Chevalier and the move breaks down.
73' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
73' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
72' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
71' Substitution. Adam Ounas (Lille) replaces Ivan Cavaleiro.
70' What was Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
68' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to substitute Jordan Veretout and he is replaced by Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) is coming onto the pitch as Samuel Gigot cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
62' Ismaily (Lille) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
59' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
58' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
57' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
55' That's unlucky! Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
54' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) sends the corner into the box, but Pau Lopez intercepts it and averts the threat.
53' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' A lofted cross from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
49' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
47' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Lucas Chevalier.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Amine Harit (Marseille) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
44' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Amine Harit (Marseille) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
41' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
39' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stephanie Frappart saw the whole situation.
39' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Valentin Rongier (Marseille).
38' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
34' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
33' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
33' Angel Gomes (Lille) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Edon Zhegrova (Lille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
30' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' Amine Harit (Marseille) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
27' Benjamin Andre (Lille) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
26' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Amine Harit (Marseille).
24' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
23' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
23' The ball is behind the sideline. Ismaily (Lille) takes a throw-in.
22' The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.
18' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
15' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the crossbar! If it had flown a little bit lower it would have been a cracker!
13' Renan Lodi (Marseille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals.
12' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
11' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
11' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
10' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' It's a nice effort by Valentin Rongier (Marseille) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lucas Chevalier. Easy save.
9' Amine Harit (Marseille) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
8' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
6' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
5' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
4' A pass by Tiago Santos (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Marseille will take a throw-in.
3' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) plays a through ball but overhits it.
2' Amine Harit (Marseille) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Marseille will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
